# #239 Profile-change coach alert ## Parent
#236
## What to build
When a coached player changes their injuries/limitations or equipment access, their coach gets a Coach alert showing what changed, so the coach can adjust the program.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A new coach alert kind, profile change, fires when a player on an active assignment changes injuries/limitations or equipment access. It doesn't fire for a goal or weight change, or for a player without an active assignment. - [ ] The alert carries only the before and after values of the changed fields, projected through the existing alert allowlists. No other profile data is included. - [ ] While a profile-change alert is open for the assignment, repeated edits update it (keeping the earliest "before" and the latest "after") instead of creating new alerts. After it is resolved, a new edit opens a new one. - [ ] Alert creation is best-effort after the profile write and never fails or blocks the edit. It follows the catalog gate like the other alert kinds. - [ ] The coach app shows the new kind in the alert list and on the player page with a readable before → after line. - [ ] Tests: API tests for firing, non-firing, dedupe and projection; a coach widget test for the rendered alert.
